stem: The elements in Group 2 include magnesium, calcium, strontium and barium.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Write an equation for the change representing the first ionisation energy of magnesium. Include state symbols.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Write an equation for the reaction of strontium with cold water. Include state symbols.

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text: Describe and explain the trend in reactivity observed in the reactions of these Group 2 metals with cold water.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem: The Group 2 metal nitrates decompose when heated.
parts.text: Describe fully what is seen when anhydrous calcium nitrate is heated in a test-tube and decomposition occurs.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Write an equation for the decomposition of calcium nitrate.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Describe and explain the variation in thermal stability of the Group 2 metal nitrates down the group.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Describe and explain the variation in the solubility of the Group 2 metal sulfates down the group.
